findings.description: No deploy gate: copy block runs on every applySchema; an early deploy (e.g. hotfix) would copy prematurely, double unified feed, leak events, and leave later tracker edits stale without parity failure. T8 guard is run-once, not a gate; its trigger would worsen early deploy.
findings.recommended_fix: In-repo gate: copy block (and later T8 trigger) no-op unless explicit setting on (e.g. WORK_ITEM_MERGE via SET LOCAL from migrate.ts), only cutover enables it; test skip path. Hazard note in checklist (done by main agent 2026-10-07).
